​

The Iranian Navy reitrateds its warning that vessels violating the restrictions and disregarding its warnings would face similar consequences.

​
The IRGC said the vessels had attempted to leave the strait through unauthorized routes, with their navigation and identification systems switched off, and with support from the “aggressive and terrorist US military.”
​
Iranian officials have repeatedly cautioned commercial vessels against using routes designated by Tehran as unauthorized and unsafe, stressing the need to comply with its maritime coordination requirements.

📌 Tehran, IRNA - Iran’s scientific advisor in West Asia meets with the President of the Northern Technical University of Iraq to explore ways to expand academic cooperation between Iran and Iraq.

Mohammad Javad Najafi and Jassim Fathi Ali Al-Maadidi, President of the Northern Technical University of Iraq, in Baghdad, on Saturday reviewed developing university cooperation between the two countries.
​
A central point of discussion at the meeting was the need to broaden direct ties between Iraq's Northern Technical University and Iranian universities, while creating conditions for scientific and educational collaboration that aligns with the requirements and priorities of both parties.
​
Given the specialized nature of the Northern Technical University and its extensive activity in engineering, technology, medical sciences, and applied sciences, Iranian technical and industrial universities can be important scientific partners of this university in implementing joint projects.
​
Key areas to pursue include holding training and specialized courses, exchanging professors and students, conducting joint research, using the capacity of laboratories and research centers, and cooperating in modern technologies and skills training.
​
The universities in the Islamic Republic of Iran have well-developed educational and research infrastructure as well as significant expertise across various disciplines, which could create opportunities for ongoing collaboration with the specialized colleges and institutes of the Northern Technical University.
